details.s: Elrond was a mighty Half-elf ruler who dwelt in Middle-earth from the First Age to the beginning of the Fourth Age. He was the Lord of Rivendell and father of Elladan, Elrohir, and Arwen Undómiel, the eventual wife of Aragorn II. He was given the epithet of Peredhel, Sindarin for Half-elven.
f: Lord of Rivendell;, Bearer of Vilya;, Vice-regent and herald to Gil-galad
Hugo Weaving (LOTR films), Robert Aramayo (The Rings of Power), Andrei Tolshin (Khraniteli)
